plan.purpose: Two first-selected public Ethereum deposit inputs, simulated once each at their own parent-block-end state. Development evidence, not an original-position replay or a security evaluation.
warnings: Selected once before simulation outcomes; no retries, replacement transactions, other providers or invented state.
Historical receipt amounts are reference observations only. Parent-block-end state and header differ from the original transaction position, including permit validity and interest accrual.

Gas is fixed to 5,000,000 and gas price omitted; this synthetic BASEFEE-zero unsigned execution does not validate the outer transaction signature, transaction fees, transaction inclusion, or security. The EVM may execute the original permit signature checks embedded in the unchanged calldata.
Explicit query roles cover a bounded subset of accounts, not all economic effects; raw token units are not independently valued.
Raw public RPC bodies, including errors and public permit signatures, are retained as untrusted local evidence. Terminal output uses fixed diagnostics.
Byte caps count response entity bytes delivered by fetch after HTTP decompression. An oversized or interrupted body retains only a bounded prefix and is never labeled a complete response.
This capture has no relationship to a blind holdout or a comparative Blockaid security score.
